items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR (BLS) through the American Heart Association
High School Graduate or High School GED
Comprehensive nursing experience including clinical disease entities
Ensure timely medical care is delivered as prescribed via MD orders and established plan of care in accordance with Title 22 Adult Day Health Care regulations.
Observe and collect data regarding the physical and emotional conditions of participants.
Provides concise and timely documentation which includes use of electronic medical records. Accurately documents all treatments and observations on a daily basis.
Inform RN Supervisor of any changes in participant conditions in a timely manner.
Develops, implements, modifies and documents individual care plans as dictated by regulations and patient change in condition.
Ensures the clinic has accurate and current schedules for clinical treatment and personal care needs. Oversees dietary orders for accuracy and implementation.
